name: Pusher
description: Tactile Push Button Progressive Web App with WebMCP tool support.

tools.name: push_button
tools.title: Push Button
tools.description: Presses the Big Red Button. Increments the push counter, plays tactile audio, triggers device haptics, and broadcasts the push event.

count.description: Number of times to push the button (between 1 and 100). Defaults to 1.

tools.name: get_status
tools.title: Get Status
tools.description: Retrieves the current state of Pusher including total pushes, push rate, sound settings, online status, and push notification subscription status.

tools.name: reset_counter
tools.title: Reset Counter
tools.description: Resets the global push counter back to zero.

tools.name: set_sound
tools.title: Set Sound
tools.description: Enables or mutes the tactile audio click effects.

enabled.description: Whether tactile mechanical sound should be enabled (true) or muted (false).
